info.title: Ayra API
info.description: HTTP API for the Ayra e-commerce backend. Authenticate with a Better Auth bearer token unless a route is public or webhook-signed.

get.summary: Get category by slug or nested path
get.description: Resolve a category by slug (`/categories/saree`) or nested path (`/categories/saree/jamdani`). Nested paths must match parent then child.

post.description: Create a category from a previously uploaded Cloudinary image. Upload once via POST /api/v1/media/upload?type=category. The response variants array is [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]; use variants[0] / imageUrl as image and variants[1] / mobileImageUrl as mobileImage.

get.description: Public paginated catalog of ACTIVE products. featured=true returns only featured products. onSale=true returns products with at least one variant where compareAtPrice > price. Admin may pass includeInactive=true or status=DRAFT|ACTIVE|ARCHIVED.

get.summary: Get product by id including draft and archived (admin)

patch.description: Apply one action (set-status, set-featured, set-category, delete) to up to 100 products. Returns requested/affected counts and the ids that could not be resolved.

get.summary: List available shipping options for an address

post.summary: Calculate shipping for a selected method and address
Merge local guest cart items into authenticated cart
Create a return request for a delivered order

patch.summary: Approve or reject a return request (admin)

post.summary: SSLCommerz success callback (signature-based, no bearer auth)
SSLCommerz failed callback (signature-based, no bearer auth)
SSLCommerz cancelled callback (signature-based, no bearer auth)
SSLCommerz IPN webhook (signature-based, no bearer auth)

get.summary: Get payment by id including gatewayResponse (admin)
List admin settings grouped by section
Check if variant is in wishlist

get.description: Returns active sliders that have an imageUrl. Desktop clients use imageUrl; mobile clients use mobileImageUrl and fall back to imageUrl when mobile is missing.

post.description: Create a slider from a previously uploaded Cloudinary image. Upload once via POST /api/v1/media/upload?type=slider. The response variants array is [desktop 1920x720, mobile 1080x1350]; use variants[0] as imageUrl and variants[1] as mobileImageUrl.

get.description: Aggregated storefront homepage: active sliders, top-level categories, and ordered product sections. Automatic sections fall back when no HOME collections exist.

get.summary: Get published privacy or terms document
List published FAQs grouped by active category
Get published blog post by slug
Top products by revenue or quantity

get.description: Returns Cloudinary CDN images of one type for the admin gallery. Images remain on Cloudinary; this lists unique public ids already uploaded. Excludes SOFT_DELETED. Newest first. Role-gated by type, same as upload.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.

post.description: Streams one image from disk after magic-byte validation. Role-gated by type: product/category/slider/blog require ADMIN; customer_avatar requires CUSTOMER or ADMIN. Product bulk uploads must use /media/uploads. Delivery URLs are generated on the fly (f_auto, q_auto). Cloudinary failures return 502 or 504 with { success: false, message }.

type.description: Image type. For multiple product images use POST /api/v1/media/uploads.

image.description: Image file (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). Max 5MB.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.

post.description: Uploads 1–5 product images after magic-byte validation. ADMIN only. Other image types are rejected.

images.description: Product images (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). Max 5 files, 5MB each.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.
